api: 最新收盘价溢价率信息API

description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取大陆场内公募基金的最新溢价率信息。可按基金代码批量查询，返回基金代码、最新收盘价日期、最新收盘价/涨跌幅/溢价率、近5/10/20日平均溢价率等数据。当用户想了解某场内公募基金或者对比某些场内公募基金在不同周期下的折溢价的统计数据，判断是否存在套利机会时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain latest premium/discount rate information for A-share exchange-traded funds. Supports batch query by fund code, returning fields such as fund code, latest closing price date, latest closing price/price change/premium rate, off-exchange IOPV net value/premium rate, exchange-traded net value discount/premium rate historical percentile, and average premium rate for the last 5/10/20 days. Call this interface when users want to understand the discount/premium situation of an exchange-traded fund or assess whether arbitrage opportunities exist.
